products.name: 32-inch Full HD LED Smart TV
products.quality_issues: High return rate: 'remote lag', 'WiFi drops after 2 hours', 'remote unresponsive'

market_context.festive_window: Active — Big Diwali Sale & Winter Gifting

causal_hypotheses.title: LED TV Return Rate Crisis — Quality Issue
causal_hypotheses.observation: LED TV return rate spiked to 18% this month (4x platform average). Top review complaints: 'remote lag', 'WiFi drops after 2 hours'. 43% of returns are from this single SKU. Rating dropped from 4.0 to 3.5.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Pausing LED TV ads stops new defective units shipping and prevents further rating damage. Engaging the supplier for a firmware fix or batch replacement recovers the SKU.
causal_hypotheses.action: Pause LED TV ads immediately; contact supplier for firmware update or replacement batch; add quality disclaimer to listing.
causal_hypotheses.metric: Return rate 18%→<4%; TV rating 3.5→4.0 within 30 days.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: If supplier cannot provide firmware fix within 14 days, delist the SKU.

causal_hypotheses.title: Delivery Speed — 43% Cancellations from Long Lead Time
causal_hypotheses.observation: Average delivery time 8.3 days (platform benchmark: ≤4 days). 43% of cancellations (8 orders) are due to buyers seeing long delivery estimates. Air Fryer and Robot Vacuum have 8-12 day lead times.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Switching to Snapdeal Fulfilment Centre (SFC) for high-velocity SKUs reduces delivery to 2-3 days, cutting delay-related cancellations by 80%.
causal_hypotheses.action: Enroll Bluetooth Speaker, Air Fryer, and Mixer Grinder in Snapdeal SFC; reduce Robot Vacuum lead time by pre-positioning units in Delhi warehouse.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: SFC onboarding takes 5 business days; manage inventory buffer during transition.

causal_hypotheses.title: Big Diwali Sale Missed — Festive Recovery Plan
causal_hypotheses.observation: Home Electronics grew +15% in November. Farouk missed the Big Diwali Sale enrollment window. Air Fryer and Robot Vacuum are OOS during peak gifting season.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Enrolling in Winter Gifting Sale and restocking Air Fryer (demand: 62/month) captures post-Diwali gifting surge.
causal_hypotheses.action: Restock Air Fryer within 72 hours; enroll Mixer Grinder and Bluetooth Speaker in Snapdeal Winter Gifting Sale.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Restrict enrollment to SKUs with delivery SLA ≤4 days.

playbook.title: Electronics Return Rate & Quality Issue Resolution
playbook.text: LED TV return rate at 18% (4x platform average). Immediately pause sponsored ads on the TV listing. Contact supplier for firmware update addressing 'remote lag' and 'WiFi instability'. Add quality assurance note to listing. If firmware fix not available in 14 days, initiate SKU delisting to protect overall account health.

playbook.title: Delivery Speed Improvement & SFC Enrollment
playbook.text: 43% of cancellations are from delivery delays (avg 8.3 days vs 4-day benchmark). Enroll Bluetooth Speaker and Mixer Grinder in Snapdeal Fulfilment Centre (SFC) for 2-3 day delivery. Pre-position Robot Vacuum units in Delhi SFC warehouse to reduce lead time from 12 to 3 days.

playbook.title: Electronics OOS Recovery — Air Fryer & Robot Vacuum
playbook.text: Air Fryer (62 units/month demand) and Robot Vacuum (28 units/month) are OOS during peak Diwali gifting season. Emergency restock Air Fryer within 72 hours from supplier. Pause ads on both OOS listings immediately to avoid cancellations and further account health penalties.

playbook.title: Post-Diwali Winter Gifting Campaign
playbook.text: Home Electronics grew 15% in November. Despite missing Big Diwali Sale, Winter Gifting campaign runs Nov 20 - Dec 15. Enroll Mixer Grinder and Bluetooth Speaker (both in-stock, good ratings) in the Winter Gifting Sale. Gold Seller status grants free banner placement in Electronics category pages.

playbook.title: Electronics Pricing vs Market Benchmark
playbook.text: LED TV priced ₹12,999 vs market ₹11,499 (13% premium) while having quality issues — double handicap. Pause TV ads rather than price-cut during quality investigation. Air Fryer at ₹3,499 vs ₹2,999 market — once restocked, price at ₹3,199 retaining 37% net margin.
